messages:
lina: FYI security tooling just flagged our windows-builder base image (windows-build-2024-11) for a suspicious unsigned binary found in /opt/tools. We need a fast mitigation plan.

chris: How urgent? Are builds compromised or just the image?

lina: Defender scan found a binary with network callbacks that we don't recognize. It's only in the vm image used by our self-hosted Windows GHA runners and internal nightly builds. No production infra affected.

qamar: Steps we should take now?

lina: Immediate steps: 1) Mark image deprecated in the image registry and disable new job assignments to runners using that image. 2) Quarantine any runners still live that booted from it. 3) Re-bake a clean image from upstream sources (win-base-2026-01) and publish as windows-build-2026-01.
messages_2:
sec-bot: Alert posted to incident tracker #INC-2026-042. Automated artifact scan scheduled for all builds run on that image in the last 30 days.

platform-oncall: I'm taking the runner pool offline for 30 minutes to prevent new jobs. Will post status.

chris: For artifact scanning, what's the command?

lina: Use ./tools/artifact-scanner --since 30d --image windows-build-2024-11 --output reports/win-image-artifacts.csv. Also run the quick list to find which repos used the image: gcloud compute images list --filter="name~windows-build-2024-11" --project redwood-ci || aws ec2 describe-images --filters Name=name,Values=windows-build-2024-11

qamar: If we find a compromised artifact, containment?
lina: Revoke any CI tokens that were available to the runner during affected jobs, rotate service account creds used by the runner host, and re-run failing builds on the new image. Notify affected repo owners.

chris: ETA for new image bake?

platform-oncall: Baking now from locked-down sources. ETA 2 hours. Will publish AMI/VM image ID and update runner fleet when ready.

lina: I'll open a short advisory to eng + infra with playbook and list of potentially affected repos. Office hours in #eng-security at 3pm PT. If you maintain a repo that uses self-hosted Windows runners, please stop merges until we confirm.
messages_3:
qamar: Thanks. Also will add a check to the image CI that verifies signed binaries and hashes pre-publish.

lina: Good call. We'll add an allowlist of signed vendor binaries and block anything unsigned during image build.

sec-bot: Remediation checklist created: https://internal/incidents/INC-2026-042 (internal). Teams with failing scans will get direct mentions.

platform-oncall: Runner pool back online with new image ID: windows-build-2026-01-ami-0abcd1234. Please requeue jobs if needed.

lina: Closing loop: if you see any odd network calls from CI artifacts, escalate immediately and ping @lina and @platform-oncall. :shield:
